## Path Animation

![](/images/pastedGraphic-490.jpg)

*Making a model move along a path couldn’t be simpler. Add a Spline Tracking tag to the object and then assign the path to it. You can add a second rail path for greater control.*

> **Note:** this section is a stub (one caption). It omits the key step: to move the object, key the Spline Tracking tag’s **Position** (0 = start of the spline, 1 = end); **Align to tangent**, **Rail**, and **All segments** are also worth a sentence (manual: Tags › Spline Tracking Tag). <!-- TODO editorial -->
